reason: The agent gave the wrong free-cancellation cutoff. The policy says cancellations are free only up to 2 hours before the booking, but the agent said 30 minutes before.
name: Free cancellation cutoff

spec.goal: Find out how late you can cancel a table without a fee.
spec.behavior: You are polite and brief. Mention that you have a booking and ask until when you can cancel without paying. If they answer, you can repeat the cutoff back once to confirm, then end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Cancellations are free only up to 2 hours before the booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says free cancellation is only available until two hours before the booking, and does not say thirty minutes before.
